title: Review and close demo card (kanban-empowered trial)
body: This is a demo card created to trial the Kanban board and is explicitly marked safe to delete. There is no functional work to perform. Worker steps: (1) Confirm the card has no linked parent or child tasks and no meaningful content beyond the title. (2) If confirmed, mark the task complete with a brief note stating it was a demo placeholder and no action was needed (or archive/delete it if the board permits). (3) If any unexpected dependencies or content are found, leave a comment describing them and do not delete. Acceptance criteria: the card is closed or removed, and a short completion note records what was done.
